title: List Chart of Accounts — happy path, paginated, company-scoped
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.VIEW). Company bootstrapped with seeded CoA.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/accounts.
2. Confirm table loads with columns: code, name, type badge, normal balance, status.
3. Verify paginator present (app-paginator).
4. Check meta has page/size/totalElements/totalPages/hasNext.
testData: Default seeded CoA for the active company.
expected: Table renders account rows. Each row shows accountCode, name, AccountType badge, DEBIT/CREDIT, ACTIVE. ApiResponse envelope with meta. No raw uid in any cell.

title: Create ASSET account — normal balance derived as DEBIT
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.MANAGE). Active company exists.
steps:
1. Click 'Add account'.
2. Enter code '1100', name 'Bank - Operating', type = ASSET.
3. Submit.
4. Read the returned row.
expected: HTTP 201. Row appears with normalBalance=DEBIT (derived server-side). status=ACTIVE. Duplicate code for same company must return 4xx.

title: Create LIABILITY account — normal balance CREDIT
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Add account code '2100', name 'VAT Payable', type=LIABILITY.
2. Submit.
3. Check normalBalance.
expected: normalBalance=CREDIT derived server-side. status=ACTIVE.

title: Create EQUITY account (CREDIT) and INCOME account (CREDIT) — normal balance coverage
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Add code '3900', name 'Retained Earnings', type=EQUITY. Submit.
2. Add code '4000', name 'Sales Revenue', type=INCOME. Submit.
expected: Both return normalBalance=CREDIT. EQUITY account needed for year-end close config.

title: Deactivate an account — excluded from journal pickers thereafter
preconditions: An active account with no postings exists.
steps:
1. Click 'Deactivate' on the account row.
2. Confirm status change.
3. Navigate to /admin/gl/journals/post and open the account dropdown for a line.
4. Confirm the deactivated account is absent.
testData: Any active EXPENSE account with zero postings.
expected: Account becomes inactive. Not selectable in the journal form (listAllActiveAccounts filter). API POST to inactive account uid returns 4xx (BR-GL-04).

title: GL.VIEW-only role cannot create accounts — button hidden and API 403
preconditions: Custom role with GL.VIEW only (no GL.MANAGE). Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/accounts.
2. Confirm 'Add account' button is absent.
3. POST directly to /api/v1/gl/accounts with valid payload.
expected: UI hides create control. API returns HTTP 403.

title: CoA multi-tenant isolation — company-A user cannot read company-B accounts
preconditions: Two companies A and B each with distinct accounts. User assigned to company A only.
steps:
1. List accounts as company-A user — only A's accounts shown.
2. Call GET /api/v1/gl/accounts?companyId=<B-id>.
3. Call GET /api/v1/gl/accounts/uid/<B-account-uid>.
testData: Company A accounts; company B account uid.
expected: Step 1: only A's rows. Step 2: 403 from assertCanActIn. Step 3: 403 scope-denied.

title: Post a balanced 2-line manual journal — debits equal credits
preconditions: Two active accounts in an OPEN fiscal period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.POST).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/journals/post.
2. Enter description 'June accrual'; posting date in an OPEN period.
3. Line 1: account 'Bank - Operating', debit 1000.00.
4. Line 2: account 'Sales Revenue', credit 1000.00.
5. Confirm running totals show Debits=1000, Credits=1000, Difference=0.
6. Click Post.
testData: DR 1000.00 / CR 1000.00; posting date in current OPEN period.
expected: HTTP 201. JB-#### batch number in success toast. Entry has sourceType=MANUAL, reversalOfId=null, two balanced lines. Navigate to detail page /admin/gl/journals/uid/{uid}.

title: Reject unbalanced journal — client guard disables Post; server enforces BR-GL-01
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.POST). OPEN period exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/journals/post.
2. Enter line1 DR 1000.00, line2 CR 900.00.
3. Observe Difference = 100.00 — 'Post' button remains disabled.
4. Bypass UI: POST unbalanced body directly to /api/v1/gl/journals.
expected: UI never enables Post while unbalanced. Direct API call returns 4xx with errors[] 'Journal entry is unbalanced (BR-GL-01)'. Even 0.01 difference must reject.

title: Reject posting into a CLOSED fiscal period — BR-GL-03
preconditions: A fiscal period that is CLOSED. Balanced journal lines ready.
steps:
1. Close a period (or use an already-closed one).
2. Set posting date inside the closed period.
3. Post a balanced entry.
testData: Posting date = any date within the closed period.
expected: Server rejects: no OPEN period resolved for the date. Error surfaced inline. No partial write (transactional rollback).

title: Reject line with both debit and credit amounts — BR-GL-08
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.POST).
steps:
1. Enter a journal line with DR 500 AND CR 500.
2. Observe UI error.
3. API-post the same line.
expected: UI: 'A line cannot have both a debit and a credit amount.' API: 4xx 'must have a positive debit OR a positive credit, not both or neither (BR-GL-08)'. A line with both zero also rejected.

title: Reverse a MANUAL journal — append-only correction, BR-GL-02/C9
preconditions: A posted MANUAL journal in an OPEN period. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.POST).
steps:
1. Open the journal detail at /admin/gl/journals/uid/:uid.
2. Click 'Reverse'.
3. Read the new reversing entry.
testData: Original entry JB-0001 with DR Bank 1000 / CR Revenue 1000.
expected: HTTP 201. New entry: lines swapped (DR Revenue 1000 / CR Bank 1000). sourceType=MANUAL. reversalOfId = original id. Original entry unchanged (append-only). Both entries visible in journals list.

title: Reverse button hidden for system-sourced entries (SALES, OPENING_BALANCE)
preconditions: A journal with sourceType=SALES exists (auto-posted from a sales invoice).
steps:
1. Open a SALES-sourced journal detail.
2. Inspect action controls.
expected: No 'Reverse' button rendered. Only MANUAL entries are reversible via this screen. OPENING_BALANCE and YEAR_END_CLOSE entries likewise show no Reverse button.

title: GL.VIEW-only user cannot post or reverse — nav/route forbidden, API 403
preconditions: Custom role with GL.VIEW only. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Attempt to navigate to /admin/gl/journals/post.
2. Open a MANUAL journal detail — confirm Reverse button absent.
3. POST to /api/v1/gl/journals directly.
4. POST to /api/v1/gl/journals/uid/{uid}/reverse directly.
expected: Route /journals/post is forbidden (requirePermission guard). Reverse button absent. Both API calls return 403.

title: Open a new fiscal year — creates 12 monthly periods all OPEN
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.PERIOD.CLOSE). No duplicate yearCode for this company.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/periods.
2. Click 'Open fiscal year'.
3. Enter yearCode 'FY2027', startMonth=1, calendarYear=2027.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. New FiscalYearDto status=OPEN. 12 monthly periods created Jan-Dec 2027, each OPEN. Year appears in years list.

title: Close a fiscal period (OPEN → CLOSED) — subsequent journal posts rejected
preconditions: An OPEN fiscal period exists. Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (GL.PERIOD.CLOSE).
steps:
1. Click 'Close' on an OPEN period row.
2. Confirm toast 'Period N closed'.
3. Attempt to post a balanced journal with a date inside this period.
testData: An OPEN period for the current company.
expected: Period status → CLOSED. closedAt stamped. Journal post into the closed period rejected (BR-GL-03). Closing an already-CLOSED period → 409 'already CLOSED'.

title: Reopen a CLOSED fiscal period (CLOSED → OPEN)
preconditions: A CLOSED fiscal period. GL.PERIOD.CLOSE permission.
steps:
1. Click 'Reopen' on a CLOSED period row.
2. Post a journal with a date in the reopened period.
expected: Status → OPEN. closedAt cleared. Journal posting into the period works again. Reopening an already-OPEN period → 409 'already OPEN'.

title: Trial balance footer: totalDebits == totalCredits (balanced books)
preconditions: At least one balanced posted journal. GL.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/trial-balance.
2. Select company.
3. Read footer totals.
testData: Company with at least one posted balanced journal.
expected: Rows show accountCode, name, totalDebit, totalCredit, net. Footer totalDebits == totalCredits. 'Balanced' indicator true. Rows grouped by AccountType in order ASSET, LIABILITY, EQUITY, INCOME, EXPENSE.

title: Trial balance period filter — known FE/BE contract gap G1
preconditions: Postings spanning at least 2 periods. GL.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. In the UI pick a period in the period <select> and observe the network request.
2. Call GET /api/v1/gl/trial-balance/period?companyId=<id>&periodId=<numeric-period-id> directly with the correct numeric id.
3. Compare the API result vs the UI request.
testData: Two periods with different posting amounts.
expected: API (direct) returns trial balance limited to the chosen period. UI is expected to send periodUid instead of numeric periodId, causing the filter to be ignored — capture as defect G1 if the UI result equals the unfiltered total.

title: Map RETAINED_EARNINGS posting account — required for year-end close
preconditions: A '3900 Retained Earnings' EQUITY account exists. GL.MANAGE permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/config.
2. Find the RETAINED_EARNINGS key row.
3. Click 'Set'. Pick account '3900 - Retained Earnings' from the picker by name.
4. Save.
expected: Mapping persisted. Row shows the new account code/name. Success toast. Only active accounts appear in the picker.

title: Map all four v1 sales keys: SALES_REVENUE, VAT_PAYABLE, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE, CASH
preconditions: Appropriate ASSET/INCOME/LIABILITY accounts exist. GL.MANAGE permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/config.
2. Set SALES_REVENUE to an INCOME account.
3. Set VAT_PAYABLE to a LIABILITY account.
4. Set ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE to an ASSET account.
5. Set CASH to an ASSET account.
testData: Four distinct accounts of the correct types.
expected: All four mappings saved. Re-setting an existing key overwrites the prior mapping (idempotent set). These drive sales auto-posting.

title: Close a fiscal year — net profit credited to Retained Earnings
preconditions: An OPEN year with INCOME > EXPENSE. RETAINED_EARNINGS gl_config mapped. Prior year CLOSED or absent. GL.YEAR.CLOSE permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/gl/year-end.
2. Click 'Close' on the OPEN year.
3. Read the confirmation; confirm.
4. Inspect the resulting closing journal and year status.
testData: Company with net profit for the year. RETAINED_EARNINGS mapped to account 3900.
expected: YEAR_END_CLOSE closing journal posted zeroing P&L accounts and crediting 3900 with net profit. All year periods auto-close. Year status → CLOSED with closedAt, closedBy, closingJournalUid set. Toast 'Closing journal posted to Retained Earnings.'

title: Close fiscal year — illegal transitions rejected (BR-CLOSE-04, BR-CLOSE-05)
preconditions: Various year states: already CLOSED; year with no periods; prior year still OPEN.
steps:
1. Attempt to close an already-CLOSED year.
2. Attempt to close a year with no periods.
3. Attempt to close a year whose immediately-prior year is still OPEN.
testData: Three separate scenarios each exercising one guard.
expected: 1 → 409 'already CLOSED'. 2 → 409 'has no periods'. 3 → 409 'prior fiscal year must be CLOSED first'. No partial posting on any guard failure.

title: Reopen a fiscal year — closing journal reversed, only most-recently-closed allowed
preconditions: A CLOSED year that is the most-recently-closed. GL.YEAR.CLOSE permission.
steps:
1. Click 'Reopen' on the most-recently-closed year.
2. Confirm periods reopen and closing journal reversal is created.
expected: Closing journal reversed (append-only YEAR_END_CLOSE reversal with reversalOfId). Year → OPEN. closedAt/closedBy/closingJournalUid cleared. Reopening a non-most-recently-closed year → 409 'Only the most-recently-closed may be reopened' (BR-CLOSE-10).

title: Year-end close fails when RETAINED_EARNINGS gl_config is missing or inactive
preconditions: An OPEN year. RETAINED_EARNINGS mapping removed or account deactivated.
steps:
1. Ensure RETAINED_EARNINGS key has no active account mapped.
2. Attempt to close the year.
expected: Close rejected (BR-CLOSE-11). Error surfaced inline. No partial closing journal posted.

title: List seeded dimension types — no create/delete control visible
preconditions: Company seeded with COST_CENTRE and DEPARTMENT dimensions. COSTING.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cost-centre/dimensions.
2. Observe rows for slot, code, name, builtIn, mandatory flag, status.
3. Confirm no 'Add dimension' button exists.
expected: At least Cost Centre + Department shown. No create/delete control (types are seeded — no create endpoint). Status badge per MasterStatus.

title: Toggle mandatory dimension — blocks UI-posted manual journals (gap G3)
preconditions: COSTING.MANAGE permission. COST_CENTRE dimension is OPTIONAL.
steps:
1. Toggle COST_CENTRE to mandatory.
2. Navigate to /admin/gl/journals/post.
3. Build a balanced 2-line entry (no dimension picker in the UI).
4. Post.
5. Toggle COST_CENTRE back to optional.
6. Post the same journal again.
testData: Mandatory COST_CENTRE; balanced journal DR Bank 500 / CR Revenue 500.
expected: Step 4: server rejects 'Dimension slot COST_CENTRE is mandatory; missing a value (FR-CC-08/BR-CC-03)'. Step 6: posts successfully. Confirms gap G3 — PostJournalLineRequest has no dimension field, so a mandatory slot blocks ALL manual journals from the UI.

title: Create root dimension value and child value (hierarchy)
preconditions: COSTING.MANAGE permission. COST_CENTRE dimension exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cost-centre/values.
2. Create root: code=CC-100, name='Head Office', no parent.
3. Create child: code=CC-110, name='Finance', parent=CC-100.
expected: Both return HTTP 201. Root has parentUid=null. Child references parent. Status=ACTIVE for both.

title: Delete dimension value with no postings (204); reject delete with postings (BR-CC-05)
preconditions: One value with zero postings; one value tagged on at least one journal line.
steps:
1. Delete the zero-posting value.
2. Attempt to delete the posted value.
testData: Value-A: no postings. Value-B: referenced in a posted line.
expected: Step 1: HTTP 204, row removed. Step 2: 4xx 'this value has journal postings. Use Deactivate instead.' Value-B remains active; can be deactivated afterward.

title: Sliced trial balance by COST_CENTRE — requires BOTH COSTING.VIEW and GL.VIEW
preconditions: Journal lines tagged with cost-centre values. User with COSTING.VIEW but NOT GL.VIEW.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cost-centre/report as the restricted user.
2. Attempt to run the report.
3. Repeat as a user with both COSTING.VIEW and GL.VIEW.
expected: Step 2: forbidden (API 403 — @perm.has('COSTING.VIEW') and @perm.has('GL.VIEW') both required). Step 3: report renders rows per (value × account) with totalDebit/totalCredit/net.

title: Sliced TB period filter works correctly (gap G2 — expected PASS)
preconditions: Tagged postings across at least 2 periods. COSTING.VIEW + GL.VIEW.
steps:
1. Pick a period in the report's period <select>.
2. Observe the request param in network tab.
3. Compare filtered result to unfiltered result.
testData: At least 2 periods with different posting amounts.
expected: UI sends periodId as a numeric Long (the FiscalPeriodDto.id, NOT uid). Result is filtered to that period. This is unlike the trial-balance screen's G1 gap — this one should pass.

title: Account ledger drill-down renders paginated lines for a date range
preconditions: An account with posted lines in the date range. REPORT.LEDGER.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/reporting/account-ledger.
2. Pick account by name.
3. Set fromDate and toDate.
4. Run report; page through results.
testData: Any account with at least 2 posted lines. fromDate=first of month, toDate=last of month.
expected: AccountLedgerDto with running-balance ledger lines. Paginated (default page size 50). No raw uid in cells. Missing fromDate or toDate → 4xx.

title: AR open-items list renders with pagination and ApiResponse envelope
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (AR.VIEW). At least 21 AR open items in the active company.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/invoices.
2. Confirm table loads (document no, customer, original + outstanding amount, currency, dates, status badge).
3. Verify paginator present.
4. Click NEXT, LAST, FIRST.
testData: At least 21 AR open items seeded (via sales posting or opening balances).
expected: Table with meta {page,size,totalElements,totalPages,hasNext}. No raw uid in any cell. Paging changes page param and reloads. NO-PERMISSION user: nav hidden, direct route blocked.

title: Invoice list customer/status filter — FE/BE contract gap (defect hunt TC-AR-041)
preconditions: At least 2 customers with invoices in different statuses.
steps:
1. Note unfiltered row count.
2. Apply customer filter via picker (by name).
3. Apply status filter = OPEN.
4. Compare count and contents before/after filter.
5. Inspect network request params.
testData: 2 customers: CUST-001 with OPEN invoices; CUST-002 with PAID invoices.
expected: DESIRED: only matching rows. DEFECT: ArService sends customerUid and status params; ArInvoiceController only binds companyId and customerId (Long). Server ignores customerUid/status — list returns all company rows. Assert if filtered count truly narrows; log contract defect if it does not.

title: Record receipt: CASH, auto oldest-first allocation, fully allocated
preconditions: Customer with at least 2 OPEN invoices. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/receipts/record.
2. Pick customer by name.
3. Amount=1000.00, currency=TZS, tender=CASH, date=today.
4. Wait for open invoices to load in allocation editor.
5. Click 'Auto oldest-first'.
6. Confirm allocated total=1000.00, unallocated=0.
7. Submit.
testData: Invoice A outstanding 600.00; Invoice B outstanding 400.00. Receipt amount 1000.00.
expected: HTTP 201. ArReceiptDto status=ALLOCATED, unallocatedAmount=0, two allocation lines. Each invoice outstanding → 0, status → PAID. Success alert shows receipt number (RCT-####).

title: Record receipt: MOBILE_MONEY, partial allocation — receipt PARTIAL, invoice PARTIAL
preconditions: Customer with one OPEN invoice outstanding 1000.00. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD permission.
steps:
1. Pick customer, amount=1000.00, tender=MOBILE_MONEY, bank reference = 'MPE-9001'.
2. Allocate 600.00 against the invoice (leave 400.00 on-account).
3. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Receipt status=PARTIAL, unallocatedAmount=400.00. Invoice outstanding=400.00, status=PARTIAL. bankReference round-trips to the receipt DTO.

title: Record receipt fully on-account (no allocation) — status UNALLOCATED
preconditions: Customer with zero open invoices. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD permission.
steps:
1. Pick customer, amount=500.00, CASH, no allocations.
2. Submit.
testData: Amount 500.00, no invoice to allocate against.
expected: HTTP 201. Receipt status=UNALLOCATED, unallocatedAmount=500.00, empty allocation list.

title: Client guard blocks over-allocation; server rejects allocation exceeding outstanding (BR-AR-04)
preconditions: Customer with one invoice outstanding 1000.00. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD permission.
steps:
1. Receipt amount=800.00. Attempt to allocate 900.00 against the invoice.
2. Observe row highlight and submit button state.
3. Via API, POST allocation=150.00 against invoice with outstanding=100.00.
expected: Step 2: row flagged table-danger, Submit disabled (anyAllocationExceedsOutstanding()). Step 3: 4xx 'exceeds outstanding (BR-AR-04)'. No receipt created (TX rollback).

title: Record receipt with WHT_ON_RECEIPT leg — GL: Cash DR reduced, WHT receivable DR, AR CR
preconditions: Active WHT type with kind=WHT_ON_RECEIPT. Customer with OPEN invoice. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/receipts/record.
2. Pick customer, amount=1000.00, fully allocate.
3. Select WHT type by name, enter whtAmount=50.00.
4. Submit.
5. Fetch linked GL entry.
expected: HTTP 201. GL: Cash DR=950.00, WHT Receivable DR=50.00, AR Control CR=1000.00. Total balances. WHT certificate linked to journal entry uid.

title: GL posting failure rolls back the entire receipt (atomicity check)
preconditions: Company missing ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE gl_config or period closed for the receipt date.
steps:
1. POST a receipt that will fail GL config resolution or period check.
2. Re-query /api/v1/ar/receipts for the company.
testData: Receipt date in a CLOSED period, or AR gl_config unset.
expected: Error response. No receipt row created. No allocation row. Invoices unchanged. Atomic rollback.

title: Write-off an OPEN invoice — status WRITTEN_OFF, GL DR Bad-Debt / CR AR
preconditions: An OPEN invoice with outstanding > 0. AR.WRITEOFF permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/invoices.
2. Click 'Write off' on the target invoice row.
3. Enter reason 'Customer insolvent', accept today's date.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Invoice outstanding → 0, status → WRITTEN_OFF. GL: DR Bad-Debt Expense / CR AR Control at carrying base. List refreshes, badge secondary. AR.VIEW-only user: action hidden, API 403.

title: Write-off illegal transitions — PAID and already WRITTEN_OFF invoices rejected
preconditions: One PAID invoice; one already WRITTEN_OFF invoice.
steps:
1. POST a write-off against the PAID invoice.
2. POST a write-off against the WRITTEN_OFF invoice.
expected: Both return 4xx. Invoice-A: 'is already PAID — cannot write off.' Invoice-B: 'is already WRITTEN_OFF.' No GL post, no write-off row in either case.

title: Raise credit note against OPEN invoice — outstanding reduced, status PARTIAL
preconditions: An OPEN invoice outstanding 1000.00 in TZS. AR.CREDITNOTE permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/invoices.
2. Click 'Credit note' on the invoice row.
3. Enter net=200.00, VAT=36.00, reason='Price adjustment'.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Invoice outstanding → 764.00, status PARTIAL. GL: DR Revenue + DR VAT / CR AR Control. AR.VIEW-only: action hidden, API 403.

title: Credit note customerUid contract bug — FE sends numeric supplierId (defect TC-AR-026)
preconditions: An OPEN invoice on the list. AR.CREDITNOTE permission.
steps:
1. Open the credit-note modal from an invoice row.
2. Enter valid net/VAT/reason and submit.
3. Inspect the request body (customerUid field) and the response.
expected: DESIRED: credit note posts successfully. DEFECT: ar-invoices-list.component.ts sends customerUid=String(inv.customerId) (numeric DB id, not the uid). Backend customers.findByCompanyIdAndUid() fails with 404/400 'Customer not found'. Capture response code; log defect if confirmed.

title: Credit note amount exceeding outstanding rejected
preconditions: Invoice outstanding 100.00. AR.CREDITNOTE permission.
steps: 1. POST credit note with total (net+VAT) = 150.00 against the invoice.
expected: 4xx 'Credit note amount exceeds outstanding'. Nothing posted. Currency mismatch (credit ≠ invoice currency) also rejected.

title: Set AR opening balance — creates OPENING_BALANCE open item, GL DR AR / CR Equity
preconditions: A customer exists. AR.OPENING.SET permission. ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE and OPENING_BALANCE_EQUITY gl_configs mapped.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/opening-balance.
2. Pick customer by name.
3. Enter amount=5000.00, currency=TZS, invoiceDate, documentNo='OB-2026-001'.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. ArInvoiceDto with source=OPENING_BALANCE, status=OPEN, outstanding=5000.00. GL: DR AR Control / CR Opening Balance Equity. Form resets after success.

title: AR opening balance GL failure rolls back — no open item created
preconditions: Company missing OPENING_BALANCE_EQUITY or ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE gl_config.
steps: 1. POST an opening balance. 2. Check ar_invoices for the company.
expected: Error response. No ar_invoices row created (atomic, synchronous post).

title: Customer statement renders total outstanding, ageing buckets, open items, recent receipts
preconditions: Customer with OPEN/PARTIAL invoices across due-date ranges and at least 1 receipt. AR.STATEMENT.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/statement.
2. Pick customer by name.
3. Read totalOutstanding headline, ageing-bucket table, open-items table, last-10 receipts.
testData: Customer with invoices in CURRENT, D1_30, D31_60 buckets.
expected: totalOutstanding == sum of OPEN/PARTIAL outstanding. Ageing buckets: CURRENT/D1_30/D31_60/D61_90/D90_PLUS. Statement call: DEFECT WATCH — FE sends customerUid but controller requires customerId (Long) — if 400/type-bind error occurs, confirm defect TC-AR-042.

title: Ageing bucket classification boundaries — CURRENT/D1_30/D31_60/D61_90/D90_PLUS
preconditions: One OPEN invoice per boundary: due=today(0), overdue 1d, 30d, 31d, 60d, 61d, 90d, 91d+. AR.STATEMENT.VIEW.
steps:
1. GET /api/v1/ar/ageing?companyId=<id>&customerId=<id>&asAt=today.
2. Read buckets and amounts.
testData: 8 invoices with daysOverdue spanning each boundary.
expected: daysOverdue<=0 → CURRENT; 1-30 → D1_30; 31-60 → D31_60; 61-90 → D61_90; >=91 → D90_PLUS. Backend AgeingBucket enum: CURRENT, D1_30, D31_60, D61_90, D90_PLUS (NOT DAYS_1_30 etc — that is the FE mismatch).

title: Ageing FE↔BE param and shape mismatch — defect TC-AR-043
preconditions: Company with aged invoices. AR.STATEMENT.VIEW permission.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ar/ageing.
2. Observe the GET /ar/ageing network call and its params.
3. Observe the response shape and rendered labels.
testData: Company with invoices in multiple buckets.
expected: DEFECT (3 parts): (a) FE omits customerId, BE requires it — expect 400. (b) BE returns List<{bucket,amount,currency}> per bucket; FE model expects per-customer rows {customerCode, current, days1to30...} — render mismatch. (c) FE bucket labels (DAYS_1_30, DAYS_91_PLUS) differ from BE enum (D1_30, D90_PLUS). Assert and log all three parts.

title: Invoice status lifecycle: OPEN → PARTIAL → PAID via receipts
preconditions: One OPEN invoice outstanding 1000.00. AR.RECEIPT.RECORD + AR.VIEW.
steps:
1. Record receipt 400.00 allocated to the invoice → check status.
2. Record receipt 600.00 allocated to the remaining → check status.
3. Verify on list each time.
expected: After step 1: status=PARTIAL, outstanding=600.00. After step 2: status=PAID, outstanding=0.00. Attempting to allocate to a PAID invoice rejected.

title: Invoice status lifecycle: OPEN → WRITTEN_OFF (terminal) — subsequent allocations blocked
preconditions: One OPEN invoice. AR.WRITEOFF + AR.RECEIPT.RECORD.
steps:
1. Write off the invoice.
2. Attempt to record a receipt allocated to the written-off invoice.
3. Attempt a second write-off.
expected: Invoice → WRITTEN_OFF (terminal). Receipt allocation editor does not show WRITTEN_OFF items (only OPEN/PARTIAL fetched). Second write-off → 'already WRITTEN_OFF' rejection.

title: AR.VIEW-only role — can view but cannot record receipt, write-off, or raise credit note
preconditions: Custom role with AR.VIEW only. Logged in as that user.
steps:
1. Open /admin/ar/invoices — list renders.
2. Confirm Write-off and Credit-note actions absent.
3. Confirm 'Record Receipt' nav item hidden.
4. POST to /ar/receipts, /ar/write-offs, /ar/credit-notes directly.
expected: List renders. All write actions hidden. All direct API POSTs return 403.

title: AR data is company-scoped — cross-company invoices, receipts, write-offs denied
preconditions: Tenant A and Tenant B each with AR data. Logged in as Tenant-A ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. List /api/v1/ar/invoices?companyId=<A> → only A's rows.
2. List /api/v1/ar/invoices?companyId=<B> → 403.
3. GET /api/v1/ar/receipts/uid/<B-receipt-uid> → 403.
testData: Tenant B invoice uid; Tenant B receipt uid.
expected: Scope guard assertCanActIn denies all cross-company reads. No Tenant B data leaks.

title: Payables list visible to AP.VIEW (ORG_ADMIN); hidden for no-permission user
preconditions: At least one supplier bill exists. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (AP.VIEW). NOTE: ACCOUNTANT and PURCHASE_OFFICER are NOT seeded with AP.* perms per V12 — only ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Log in as ORG_ADMIN; navigate to /admin/ap/supplier-bills.
2. Confirm table renders with columns: Bill No., Supplier Inv. No., Supplier, Bill/Due dates, Gross, Outstanding, Currency, Status, Source.
3. Log in as NO-PERMISSION user; confirm nav hidden and direct route blocked.
testData: Company 'Acme TZ Ltd' with at least one supplier bill.
expected: ORG_ADMIN: table renders, paginator present, ApiResponse with meta. NO-PERMISSION: route guard redirects, forbidden alert shown, API 403.

title: Supplier column shows numeric id instead of name — DEF-AP-04 (defect hunt)
preconditions: A bill for a named supplier. ORG_ADMIN logged in.
steps:
1. Open /admin/ap/supplier-bills.
2. Inspect the Supplier column on any row.
expected: DESIRED: human-readable supplier name/code shown. DEFECT: bill.supplierId (numeric DB id) is rendered — C1 violation. Capture the actual rendered value; log DEF-AP-04 if confirmed.

title: Enter GOODS bill against PO — auto 3-way match → MATCHED + GL posted
preconditions: Approved PO and goods receipt exist for the supplier. ORG_ADMIN (AP.BILL.ENTER + AP.BILL.MATCH). Line cost within 2% tolerance of PO.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ap/supplier-bills/enter.
2. Pick supplier by name (typeahead).
3. Pick PO via picker by PO number. Select PO line per bill line.
4. Enter supplier invoice no, bill date, due date, VAT amount, currency TZS.
5. Add line: description, billed qty=10, unit cost=1000.00.
6. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201 with DRAFT bill (BILL-####). Inline match returns BillMatchResultDto with each line MATCHED. Bill status → MATCHED. GL: DR Purchases / CR AP-Control posted (postedGlEntryUid appears). ACCOUNTANT: route forbidden (no AP grants per V12).

title: Bill held on price variance > 2% tolerance; accept variance → MATCHED + GL posts
preconditions: PO line cost 1000.00. ORG_ADMIN (AP.BILL.MATCH). Bill to be entered at 1200.00.
steps:
1. Enter bill with unit cost=1200.00 (20% over PO cost).
2. Observe inline match result after submit.
3. Confirm bill status=HELD, no GL posted yet.
4. Click 'Accept Variance' for the line.
5. Confirm bill → MATCHED and GL is posted.
expected: After step 2: line badge HELD_PRICE_VARIANCE with priceVarianceAmount/priceVariancePct. Bill=HELD. After step 4: line=VARIANCE_ACCEPTED, bill=MATCHED, GL posted. User without AP.BILL.MATCH cannot accept (403).

title: Re-running match on a PAID bill is rejected (illegal transition)
preconditions: A fully-paid bill (status=PAID). ORG_ADMIN (AP.BILL.MATCH).
steps: 1. POST /api/v1/ap/supplier-bills/uid/{paidBillUid}/match/run.
expected: 4xx/409 rejected — only DRAFT/HELD are matchable. Bill remains PAID. No double posting.

title: Payment run over selected MATCHED bills — PAYMENT_RUN kind, GL posted atomically
preconditions: Supplier with at least 2 MATCHED bills. ORG_ADMIN (AP.PAYMENT.RUN).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ap/payments/record.
2. Pick supplier by name.
3. Select all payable bills; confirm Selected count and total update.
4. Payment date=today, tender=BANK_TRANSFER, bankReference='TT-55'.
5. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201 with ApPaymentDto (kind=PAYMENT_RUN, PAYRUN-####). Each bill moves to PARTIALLY_PAID/PAID. GL: DR AP / CR Cash posted atomically. NOTE: controller returns single ApPaymentDto but FE types response as ApPaymentDto[] — flag render issue if occurs.

title: Payment run with WHT-on-payment — Cash CR reduced by WHT, WHT leg posted
preconditions: Active WHT type with kind=WHT_ON_PAYMENT. A payable bill. ORG_ADMIN (AP.PAYMENT.RUN).
steps:
1. On Record Payment, pick supplier; select a bill.
2. Choose WHT type by name, enter whtAmount=50.00.
3. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Cash CR = 950.00; WHT payable leg captured. Payment recorded for gross with WHT withheld. WHT amount 0/blank → no WHT leg sent.

title: Pay single bill — partial payment (SINGLE kind) → bill PARTIALLY_PAID
preconditions: One MATCHED bill outstanding 1000.00. ORG_ADMIN (AP.PAYMENT.RUN).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ap/payments.
2. Open 'Pay Single Bill' form; pick bill by number.
3. Amount=400.00, tender=CASH.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. ApPaymentDto kind=SINGLE, allocation=400.00. Bill → PARTIALLY_PAID, outstanding=600.00. GL: DR AP / CR Cash.

title: Second payment fully settles bill → status PAID, outstanding 0
preconditions: A PARTIALLY_PAID bill with 600.00 outstanding. ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Pay the remaining 600.00 via single-pay form.
expected: Bill → PAID, outstanding=0.00. A second ApPaymentDto (SINGLE) created — separate append-only payment, not an edit of the prior one.

title: Raise debit note against MATCHED bill — outstanding reduced, GL posted (DEF-AP-03 watch)
preconditions: A MATCHED bill outstanding 1000.00. ORG_ADMIN (AP.DEBITNOTE).
steps:
1. On Payables list, click 'Debit Note' on a MATCHED row.
2. Enter Note Date, Net=200.00, VAT=0, Reason='Damaged goods returned'.
3. Submit.
expected: DESIRED: HTTP 201 ApDebitNoteDto (DN number, amount, reason). Bill outstanding → 800.00. GL: DR AP / CR Purchases. DEFECT DEF-AP-03: modal sends supplierUid=String(bill.supplierId) (numeric id). Backend uid-resolution fails → 400/404. Capture response; log if defect confirmed.

title: Debit note action hidden for DRAFT/HELD/PAID status and for roles lacking AP.DEBITNOTE
preconditions: Bills in DRAFT, HELD, PAID statuses. Custom AP.VIEW-only role.
steps:
1. As ORG_ADMIN: confirm 'Debit Note' button only on MATCHED/APPROVED/PARTIALLY_PAID rows.
2. As AP.VIEW-only user: confirm no 'Debit Note' button on any row.
expected: Button visibility = canDebitNote() AND payable status. AP.VIEW-only → button absent on all rows.

title: Set AP opening balance for a supplier — source=OPENING_BALANCE, GL posted
preconditions: An ACTIVE supplier. ORG_ADMIN (AP.OPENING.SET). ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE and OPENING_BALANCE_EQUITY gl_configs mapped.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ap/opening-balance.
2. Pick supplier by name.
3. Enter gross=5000.00, billDate=2026-01-01, dueDate=2026-01-31, supplierInvoiceNo='OB-2025'.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. SupplierBillDto source=OPENING_BALANCE, status reflects open payable. GL: DR Opening Balance Equity / CR AP posted. Bill appears in supplier's statement and Payables list.

title: Supplier statement: balance, ageing, open bills, reconciliation all render
preconditions: Supplier with outstanding across multiple ageing buckets. ORG_ADMIN (AP.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/ap/statement.
2. Pick supplier by name.
3. Read outstanding balance, ageing rows, open-bills list, reconciliation panel.
testData: Supplier 'Dar Wholesalers' with CURRENT and D1_30 bills.
expected: Balance = sum of outstanding. Ageing rows show bucket + amount + currency. Open bills exclude PAID. Reconciliation shows sub-ledger total, GL control balance, difference. Reconciliation failure does NOT block balance/ageing/bills.

title: AP ageing buckets beyond CURRENT mislabelled — DEF-AP-01
preconditions: Supplier with bills aged into D1_30, D31_60, D61_90, D90_PLUS. ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open supplier statement.
2. Inspect the ageing rows — note rendered labels and sort order.
testData: Bills with due dates spanning all buckets, asAt=today.
expected: DESIRED: rows labelled Current / 1-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ in order. DEFECT DEF-AP-01: backend emits D1_30/D31_60/D61_90/D90_PLUS; screen BUCKET_LABEL/BUCKET_ORDER keys are DAYS_1_30/DAYS_91_PLUS — non-CURRENT buckets render raw enum and sort incorrectly. Log confirmed mismatch.

title: AP reconciliation: sub-ledger total == GL control balance (difference=0.00)
preconditions: A full AP cycle completed: enter→match→pay→debit-note for one company. ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open supplier statement for any supplier in the company.
2. Read sub-ledger total, GL control balance, difference.
testData: Company 'Acme TZ Ltd' after a full P2P cycle.
expected: difference = subLedgerTotal − glControlBalance = 0.00. A non-zero difference is a finance-grade defect (BR-AP-02). Log if non-zero.

title: ACCOUNTANT and PURCHASE_OFFICER are NOT granted AP perms by seed (V12 ground truth)
preconditions: Seeded ACCOUNTANT and PURCHASE_OFFICER users.
steps:
1. Log in as ACCOUNTANT. Assert AP nav absent; AP routes forbidden; AP write APIs 403.
2. Repeat as PURCHASE_OFFICER.
expected: Both roles denied AP access (only ORG_ADMIN seeded with AP.* per V12). Confirms code-based RBAC — granting AP.VIEW to a CUSTOM role grants access regardless of role name.

title: AP.VIEW-only custom role — reads all AP screens, all write actions hidden and API 403
preconditions: Custom role granted only AP.VIEW.
steps:
1. Log in as AP.VIEW-only user.
2. Nav shows Payables, Payments, Supplier Statement; hides Enter Bill, Record Payment, AP Opening Balance.
3. Directly navigate to /admin/ap/supplier-bills/enter, /admin/ap/payments/record, /admin/ap/opening-balance.
4. POST to /supplier-bills, /payments/single, /debit-notes, /opening-balance directly.
expected: Full read access. Every direct route blocked by requirePermission guard. Every write API returns 403.

title: Tenant A cannot see Tenant B's bills, payments, statement
preconditions: Two companies A and B with AP data. Logged in as Tenant A's ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. List Payables / Payments scoped to A.
2. Open /admin/ap/supplier-bills/uid/{B-bill-uid}.
3. Open /admin/ap/payments/uid/{B-payment-uid}.
testData: Tenant B bill uid; Tenant B payment uid.
expected: Lists show only A's records. B's uids return 403/404 via @perm.scoped + company scoping. No B data leaks.

title: Cash/bank accounts list renders for CASH.VIEW holder; forbidden for no-permission user
preconditions: Company with at least 1 CASH and 1 BANK account. Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (CASH.VIEW). NOTE: only ORG_ADMIN seeded with CASH.* per V13.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/accounts.
2. Confirm table: Code, Name, Type, Bank, GL Account, Currency, Default, Active.
3. Type column shows CASH/BANK badges.
4. As NO-PERMISSION user: nav hidden, direct route blocked.
expected: Table renders. ApiResponse<CashBankAccountDto[]>. No uid anywhere in the table or DOM. axe-clean. NO-PERMISSION: forbidden alert, API 403.

title: Create CASH account — GL ASSET link required, code auto-generated
preconditions: At least 1 ASSET GL account. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.ACCOUNT.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Click 'New Account'.
2. Name='Petty Cash Box', Type=CASH.
3. GL Asset Account: pick an ASSET account by 'code - name' label.
4. Click 'Save Account'.
testData: name='Petty Cash Box'; type=CASH; GL='1000 - Cash on Hand'.
expected: HTTP 201. Toast 'Account created · Petty Cash Box'. List shows new row with auto-generated Code, currency=TZS base, Active. For CASH type: bank name/no/branch fields NOT rendered.

title: Create BANK account — bank name required; BANK-only fields appear
preconditions: At least 1 ASSET GL account. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.ACCOUNT.MANAGE).
steps:
1. New Account; Type=BANK → bank fields appear.
2. Leave Bank Name blank; Save → expect inline error.
3. Fill: name='CRDB Operating', bankName='CRDB Bank', bankAccountNo='0150xxx', bankBranch='Kariakoo'; Save.
expected: Step 2: inline error 'Bank name is required for a BANK account.' no API call. Step 3: HTTP 201. Row shows Bank column with bank name.

title: Set-default action reassigns the Default badge (single default per company)
preconditions: At least 2 accounts, one default. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.ACCOUNT.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Click 'Set default' on a non-default row.
2. Confirm spinner, toast, list reload.
3. Count Default badges.
expected: Toast 'Default account set · <name>'. Default badge moves to the new account. Exactly one Default badge in the list. 'Set default' button absent on the already-default row.

title: CASH.VIEW-only user cannot create or set-default — button hidden, API 403
preconditions: Custom role with CASH.VIEW only.
steps:
1. Log in as CASH.VIEW-only user; open /admin/cash/accounts.
2. Confirm 'New Account' and 'Set default' buttons absent.
3. POST to /api/v1/cash/accounts directly.
expected: List renders. Write buttons absent. Direct POST returns 403.

title: Record transfer between two accounts — two cash_transactions + balanced GL posted
preconditions: Two active accounts. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.TRANSFER).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/transfers/record.
2. Source='Petty Cash' (code-name picker); Destination='CRDB Operating'.
3. Source balance loads beside the picker.
4. Amount=50000, date=today, reference='Float top-up'.
5. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Toast 'Transfer recorded · CBT-####'. Backend: TRANSFER_OUT cash_transaction on source, TRANSFER_IN on destination, one balanced GL entry atomically. Balances refresh.

title: Transfer rejected when source equals destination
preconditions: At least one account. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.TRANSFER).
steps:
1. Select the same account for both source and destination.
2. Enter amount; attempt submit.
3. API-POST with equal source/dest uids.
expected: UI: submit disabled (sameAccountError). Inline error 'Source and destination accounts must differ.' No POST. API-level: 4xx with errors[].

title: Transfers list shows raw account uids — C1 violation (defect to file)
preconditions: At least one recorded transfer. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/transfers.
2. Inspect the From Account and To Account columns for any row.
3. Inspect the same fields on the transfer detail page.
expected: DEFECT: From/To Account cells render raw sourceAccountUid/destinationAccountUid ({{ row.sourceAccountUid }}) — C1 violation. CashTransferDto carries no account names so the UI cannot resolve them. Assert a raw uid string is visible; file as a defect. Same violation on the detail screen.

title: Record direct IN entry (bank interest) — cash_transaction + balanced GL posted
preconditions: At least 1 cash/bank account and 1 INCOME GL account. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.ENTRY.RECORD).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/entries/record.
2. Cash Account: pick by name.
3. Direction=IN, amount=1200.50, date=today.
4. Counter GL Account: pick an INCOME account by 'code - name'.
5. Memo='Bank interest'; submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Toast 'Entry recorded · <txnNumber>'. DIRECT_ENTRY cash_transaction + balanced GL recorded. Counter GL options exclude ASSET/LIABILITY (only INCOME/EXPENSE/EQUITY listed).

title: Record direct OUT entry (bank charge) — reduces cash balance
preconditions: At least 1 cash/bank account and 1 EXPENSE GL account. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.ENTRY.RECORD).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/entries/record.
2. Direction=OUT, counter=EXPENSE account 'Monthly bank charge'.
3. Amount=5000, date=today; submit.
expected: HTTP 201. CashTxnDirection=OUT persisted. Running statement (CB-018) later shows this OUT reducing the balance.

title: Register cheque (BANK account only) — status ISSUED; Clear/Cancel action defect (TC-CASH-041)
preconditions: At least 1 BANK account. ORG_ADMIN (CHEQUE.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/cheques.
2. Click 'Register Cheque'.
3. Bank Account: pick BANK account by name.
4. Cheque Number='100245', Payee='Tanesco', Amount=75000, Issue Date=today, Value Date=today+3.
5. Submit.
6. Inspect the new row Status and Actions.
expected: HTTP 201. Toast 'Cheque registered · 100245'. DEFECT: API returns status=ISSUED but HTML gates actions on chq.status==='PENDING'. Clear/Cancel buttons do NOT render. statusBadgeClass('ISSUED') falls through to default badge. Assert this mismatch; file defect (FE ChequeStatus should be ISSUED|CLEARED|CANCELLED, not PENDING|CLEARED|CANCELLED).

title: Clear a cheque (ISSUED → CLEARED) via API (due to UI defect)
preconditions: A cheque in ISSUED status. ORG_ADMIN (CHEQUE.MANAGE).
steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cash/cheques/uid/{uid}/clear.
2. Reload the cheques list.
expected: Status → CLEARED. clearedAt set. Toast 'Cheque cleared · <number>'. Once the UI PENDING/ISSUED defect is fixed, the UI 'Clear' button should trigger the same.

title: Cancel a cheque (ISSUED → CANCELLED)
preconditions: A cheque in ISSUED status. ORG_ADMIN (CHEQUE.MANAGE).
steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cash/cheques/uid/{uid}/cancel.
2. Reload list.
testData: Cheque in ISSUED status (different cheque from CB-012).
expected: Status → CANCELLED. cancelledAt set. Toast 'Cheque cancelled · <number>'.

title: Illegal cheque transitions from terminal states are rejected
preconditions: One CLEARED cheque; one CANCELLED cheque.
steps:
1. POST clear on a CLEARED cheque.
2. POST cancel on a CLEARED cheque.
3. POST clear on a CANCELLED cheque.
4. POST cancel on a CANCELLED cheque.
testData: Backend ChequeStatus: ISSUED, CLEARED, CANCELLED, DEPOSITED, BOUNCED.
expected: All four rejected with 4xx + errors[]. ChequeStatus terminal states (CLEARED, CANCELLED) are immutable. No status change on any attempt.

title: Cheque bounce — inbound cheque DEPOSITED → BOUNCED lifecycle (ADR-0040 D-9)
preconditions: An inbound cheque in DEPOSITED status (registered as inbound).
steps:
1. Trigger the cheque-bounce reversal event (ChequeBounceReversalHandler).
2. Read the cheque status and the linked GL reversal entry.
testData: Inbound cheque previously deposited and linked to an AR receipt.
expected: Cheque status → BOUNCED. The AR receipt reversal is posted (ChequeBounceReversalHandler re-opens the AR invoice). Backend ChequeStatus enum includes DEPOSITED and BOUNCED (ADR-0040 D-9).

title: Open reconciliation (DRAFT) for a BANK account
preconditions: A BANK account with cleared/uncleared transactions. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.RECONCILE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/reconciliations.
2. Pick BANK account by name → transactions load.
3. Click 'Open reconciliation'; enter statementDate=today, statementClosingBalance=250000.
4. Submit.
expected: HTTP 201. Reconciliation in DRAFT. Toast 'Reconciliation opened · <reconciliationNumber>'. Difference indicator and Complete button appear. Only BANK accounts in picker — CASH excluded.

title: Mark transactions cleared/uncleared — running cleared book balance updates live
preconditions: An open DRAFT reconciliation with at least 2 transactions. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.RECONCILE).
steps:
1. Tick a transaction's cleared checkbox.
2. Untick it.
3. Tick multiple transactions.
4. Observe cleared-book-balance after each toggle.
testData: Mix of IN (balance increases) and OUT (balance decreases) transactions.
expected: Each toggle persists (optimistic UI). cleared-book-balance recomputes: IN adds, OUT subtracts. Difference = clearedBookBalance - statementClosingBalance. Marking cleared on a COMPLETED reconciliation must be rejected by service.

title: Complete reconciliation gated: enabled only when cleared balance == statement closing balance
preconditions: Open DRAFT recon with transactions that can sum to the closing balance. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.RECONCILE).
steps:
1. With difference != 0: confirm Complete button disabled.
2. Tick transactions until clearedBookBalance == statementClosingBalance (within 1e-6).
3. Click Complete.
testData: statementClosingBalance=250000. Tick enough transactions to match.
expected: Step 1: disabled. Step 3: HTTP 200. Status → COMPLETED. completedAt/reconciledBy set. Toast 'Reconciliation completed'. API force-complete while unbalanced → service rejects (BR-CASH-06).

title: Illegal reconciliation transitions — re-complete and mutate after complete both rejected
preconditions: A COMPLETED reconciliation. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.RECONCILE).
steps:
1. POST complete on an already-COMPLETED reconciliation.
2. POST mark-cleared against a COMPLETED reconciliation.
expected: Both rejected with 4xx + errors[]. COMPLETED is terminal (DRAFT→COMPLETED only). UI completeDisabled=true when already COMPLETED.

title: Running-balance statement — IN adds, OUT subtracts, chronological; txnType from backend enum
preconditions: Account with mix of IN and OUT transactions (transfers + direct entries). ORG_ADMIN (CASH.VIEW).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/cash/statement.
2. Pick account by name.
3. Read transaction table with running-balance column.
testData: Account with at least 3 transactions of mixed direction.
expected: Each row shows direction badge (IN=green/OUT=red), amount, cumulative runningBalance. Final running balance equals current balance card. txnType values from backend: AR_RECEIPT, AP_PAYMENT, TRANSFER_IN, TRANSFER_OUT, DIRECT_ENTRY (NOT FE model's RECEIPT/PAYMENT/CHEQUE). Flag label blanks if drift occurs.

title: Book vs GL reconciliation indicator — difference must be 0.00 for a healthy account
preconditions: Account whose book balance equals its linked GL account balance. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.VIEW).
steps:
1. Select account on /admin/cash/statement.
2. Read GL-reconciliation panel: bookBalance, linkedGlBalance, difference.
testData: Account with all postings originating from balanced GL entries.
expected: difference = 0.00, glReconciled=true (|difference| < 1e-6). A non-zero difference is a finance-grade defect — log it for investigation.

title: Company-wide balances and GL reconciliation via API (all accounts)
preconditions: Company with several accounts. ORG_ADMIN (CASH.VIEW).
steps:
1. GET /api/v1/cash/statements/balances?companyId=<id>.
2. GET /api/v1/cash/statements/gl-reconciliation?companyId=<id>.
3. Repeat as no-permission user.
expected: ORG_ADMIN: CashAccountBalanceDto[] and CashGlReconciliationDto[] for all accounts. No-permission: 403. Any account with non-zero difference surfaces for investigation.

title: CASH.VIEW-only user sees read-only nav; cannot access transfer/entry/cheque/reconciliation screens
preconditions: Custom role with CASH.VIEW only.
steps:
1. Log in as CASH.VIEW-only user.
2. Confirm nav shows: Cash & Bank Accounts, Transfers, Cash Statement. Hides: Cash Transfer record, Cash/Bank Entry, Cheques, Bank Reconciliation.
3. Navigate directly to /admin/cash/transfers/record, /cash/entries/record, /cash/cheques, /cash/reconciliations.
expected: Read routes accessible. Each write/action route blocked by requirePermission guard. Note: CHEQUE.MANAGE guards the cheques route (CASH.VIEW alone is not enough for that screen).

title: Cross-tenant isolation — company A cannot see company B's cash data
preconditions: Two companies A and B with cash accounts and transactions. Logged in as Tenant A's ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. List accounts/transfers/cheques scoped to A's companyId.
2. GET a Tenant B account uid directly.
3. GET a Tenant B transfer uid directly.
4. GET a Tenant B cheque uid directly.
testData: Tenant B account, transfer, cheque uids.
expected: Lists show only A's data. B's scoped-get endpoints return 403/404 via @perm.scoped helpers. No B data leaks.

title: CashTxnType FE model drifts from backend — RECEIPT/PAYMENT/CHEQUE vs AR_RECEIPT/AP_PAYMENT
preconditions: Account with AR_RECEIPT and AP_PAYMENT transactions. ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. View the cash statement for the account.
2. Inspect the rendered txnType labels for AR receipt and AP payment rows.
testData: Account with both AR_RECEIPT and AP_PAYMENT transactions.
expected: Backend emits AR_RECEIPT and AP_PAYMENT. FE model declares RECEIPT and PAYMENT. Any label lookup keyed on the FE union risks showing blank/unknown. Assert the rendered labels are readable; flag any blank/unknown as the FE/BE enum drift defect.

title: Transfer GL entry is balanced: TRANSFER_OUT debit + TRANSFER_IN credit net to zero
preconditions: Two active accounts. ORG_ADMIN. GL.VIEW to inspect the linked journal.
steps:
1. Record a transfer of 10000 from CASH to BANK.
2. Fetch the linked GL entry from the transfer detail (journalEntryRef).
3. Sum debits and credits.
expected: GL entry has exactly 2 lines: DR Cash account 10000 / CR Bank account 10000 (or vice versa depending on direction convention). totalDebits == totalCredits == 10000. Transfer is atomic — partial entries must not exist.

title: Axe accessibility sweep across all cash screens
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in with data seeded on all screens.
steps:
1. Run axe scan on: /admin/cash/accounts, /cash/transfers, /cash/transfers/record, /cash/entries/record, /cash/cheques, /cash/reconciliations, /cash/statement.
2. Open create/register forms and scan again.
testData: Accounts, transfers, entries, cheques, reconciliation all seeded.
expected: Zero serious/critical axe violations. Tables have captions + scope. Form controls have associated labels. Spinners/alerts have appropriate aria roles. Open forms (role='form' with aria-label) axe-clean.

title: Append-only ledger end-to-end: post a journal, reverse it, trial balance still balanced
preconditions: GL.POST + GL.VIEW. OPEN period exists.
steps:
1. Post a balanced manual journal; note trial balance totals.
2. Reverse it (GL-012 procedure).
3. Re-read trial balance.
expected: No edit/delete path for a posted entry anywhere in the UI. Original entry persists. Reversal nets the effect. Trial balance debits still equal credits after both entries. There is no way to call an edit or delete on journal_entry via the UI — confirmed by absence of edit controls.

title: Axe accessibility sweep on all GL and costing screens
preconditions: ACCOUNTANT (GL.VIEW + COSTING.VIEW) logged in with data seeded.
steps:
1. Run axe on: /admin/gl/accounts, /admin/gl/journals, /admin/gl/journals/post, /admin/gl/journals/uid/:uid, /admin/gl/periods, /admin/gl/trial-balance, /admin/gl/config, /admin/gl/year-end, /admin/cost-centre/dimensions, /admin/cost-centre/values, /admin/cost-centre/report, /admin/reporting/account-ledger.
2. Also scan the dynamic journal line editor (add/remove line states).
